description:
The Naver Privacy Center content API, reverse-engineered from the public
privacy.naver.com Next.js app. Naver was the first South Korean company to
publish a transparency report (January 2015) and publishes semiannual
statistics on government requests for user data going back to 2012 —
search & seizure warrants, communication user information (구 통신자료),
communication-restricting measures, and communication confirmation data
(log records) — as machine-readable JSON.

The app prefetches every page through an unauthenticated CMS API:

- `GET /api/pages/{pageCode}` returns a page's content. For pageCode
  `TRANSPARENCY_REPORT_STATISTICS` the `specificAreaJson.statistics` array
  carries the full half-year statistics series (request/processing/
  provided/average counts and compliance rates per request category, one
  entry per half-year since 2012).
- `GET /api/pages/intro/{introCode}` returns a section's intro blurb
  (e.g. `REPORT` for the transparency-report section).
- `GET /api/notices` lists Privacy Center notices (paginated with
  0-indexed `page` and `size`); `GET /api/notices/{noticeId}` returns one
  notice with prev/next links.

All endpoints are Korean-language and unauthenticated. Invalid page or
intro codes return HTTP 400 with `{"errorCode": "BAD_REQUEST", ...}`.

Known transparency-related page codes: `TRANSPARENCY_REPORT_STATISTICS`
(the statistics series), `WHAT_IS_THE_TRANSPARENCY_REPORT` (methodology),
`PROTECTING_NAVER_S_COMMUNICATION_SECRETS`,
`VERIFICATION_OF_COMMUNICATION_SECRET_PROTECTION_WORK`, and
`NAVER_REPORT` (the NAVER Privacy Report / whitepaper library, whose
`specificAreaJson.privacyWhitepapers` lists downloadable publications).
Page codes are CMS-managed strings, not a closed set.

tools.name: notices_get
tools.description: Returns one notice with its full HTML body and prev/next navigation stubs. Required: noticeId.

tools.name: notices_list
tools.description: Returns notices, newest first. Paginated with 0-indexed page and size. Optional: page (default: 0), size.

params.name: size
params.description: Page size (number of notices per page).

tools.name: pages_get
tools.description: Returns a CMS page's rendered HTML plus its structured `specificAreaJson` payload. For `TRANSPARENCY_REPORT_STATISTICS` the payload's `statistics` array is the full transparency-report series: one entry per half-year since 2012, each carrying request, processing, provided-item, and per-request-average counts plus compliance rates for search & seizure warrants, communication user information, communication-restricting measures, and communication confirmation data. Required: pageCode.

params.name: pageCode
params.description: CMS page code, e.g. TRANSPARENCY_REPORT_STATISTICS, WHAT_IS_THE_TRANSPARENCY_REPORT, NAVER_REPORT.

tools.name: pages_get-intro
tools.description: Returns the intro blurb (title, text, hero image) for a Privacy Center section. `REPORT` is the transparency-report section; `ACTIVITY` is the protection-activities section. Required: introCode.

params.name: introCode
params.description: Section intro code, e.g. REPORT or ACTIVITY.
